body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. READ-ONLY checkpoint review of /private/tmp/storymodel4s-narrative-compiler.Wk75Qb (uncommitted compiler + suite + vertical; resolve.scala +4). No gate. No bead.

Against MY prior blockers only (Q1/Q2, and the derive / fake-receipt items I had weighed). Collab B1-B4/M1-M3 were accepted by the author; I am not re-trying that court.

Q1/Q2 — CLOSED on this snapshot.
compile always returns NarrativeCompilation.of wrapping StoryModel.draft + ValidationOutcome. validated is Option. Promotion-blocking families (SituationMention, ContextAssignment, SegmentMembership, DiscourseTrajectory, Summary) force ValidationOutcome(..., None) even if StoryValidator would have promoted. AlignmentSource is not entered from a partial. That is the line I asked for: named compilation is the durable record of this step; Validated is only a successful promotion.

B2 / absence-erasing derive — CLOSED.
DiscourseTrajectory.derive is not called. Trajectory is always empty. Two-or-more emitted situations get an explicit UnsupportedTrajectoryInputs(ParticipantRole, TemporalRelation) gap per adjacent pair, and DiscourseTrajectory is a promotion-blocking family. CompilerSuite pins empty trajectory, validated=None, and trajectory.complete. One-situation compiles can still promote (accepted-evidence test, WOG vertical) because sliding(2) is empty — that is not the hole.

B13 / fake Agent WOG — CLOSED in the sense I cared about.
The vertical no longer wraps the hand-authored WOG narrative model. DeterministicFixtureProvider is named as a pure-Scala rule (stage wog-deterministic-fixture-provider, model pure-scala-rule, court wog-one-sentence-reachability). It still goes through AgentProposal / AgentCallReceipt because that is the acquire vehicle; the receipts say what they are. Mechanical reachability only, as claimed.

B3 modality/status — CLOSED on the provider surface.
SituationProposal/StorySummaryProposal/CausalProposal/ContextAssignmentProposal carry no EpistemicStatus. Compiler assigns ClaimMeta status. Non-Asserted modality is refused at input (:533-534) and pinned.

Not a blocker, first-slice only: any future temporal/participant attempt would still be ignored, because the trajectory gap is unconditional on emitted pairs. Say that in the ADR so the next slice does not have to discover it.

I hold nothing. No verdict requested, none given.
